title: Visual moral inference and communication
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the model's ability to infer moral values from images, including the association of images depicting religious acts (e.g., praying) with the 'Purity' moral foundation.
findings: The study found that images in the 'health' news category, which often depicted people praying, were most strongly associated with the 'Purity' moral foundation compared to other news categories like sports, business, science, and technology.
